angles: Thin board: across 14 Sunday games, only a few favorites show a positive averaged edge vs the DraftKings price, and none by much. Stakes are small on purpose.

0-2 teams (desperation angle): Chargers (at BUF), Commanders (vs SEA, Jayden Daniels out), Texans and Colts (vs each other), Dolphins (vs KC), Titans (at NYG), Buccaneers (vs MIN). The card needs none of them blown out -- the Fun Parlay only needs Buffalo to win, not cover.
Puka Nacua (Rams, groin/hip) is doubtful for SNF; McVay said doubtful means more unlikely than likely. Kalshi's Rams price (54%) looks like it already reflects that; ESPN's FPI (63.7%) may not.
No Lottery Ticket: this weekend's one ticket was already used Thursday (ATL @ GB), so tier 3 is a second Fun Parlay instead.

Prop board: ~65 player props across all 14 games are on the Legs tab. Almost every one is priced at or above what the models say -- books carry their margin on props. The few with 2+ sources and a positive edge are listed under Best value, and none of them is 55%+, so none went into the parlays.
No verified prices were found for sacks, tackles, kicker or D/ST markets this week (the pages that list them didn't show readable odds), so those markets are missing rather than guessed.

easy_bet.selection: Los Angeles Rams moneyline (at Denver Broncos)
easy_bet.estimated_prob_source: Averaged: ESPN FPI 63.7% + Dimers 61.3% + Kalshi 54% = 179.0 / 3 = 59.7%. Spread between sources 9.7 points (inside the 10-point limit, but close). -135 implies 57.4%, so edge is about +2.2%.
easy_bet.reason_summary: Rams ML -135 (SNF). 3 sources avg 59.7% vs 57.4% implied = small +2.2% edge. Nacua doubtful -- skip if DK is shorter than -150.
easy_bet.reason: Picked on merit: the Rams are favored by every source read -- ESPN FPI 63.7%, Dimers 61.3% (projects Rams 23-20), Kalshi 54% as of 9/26. Averaged 59.7% vs DraftKings -135 (57.4% implied) = +2.2%, a small edge, not a big one. Honest caveats: (1) Puka Nacua is doubtful (missed every practice this week) and FPI may predate that news, which is why Kalshi sits 10 points lower -- the sources are only just inside the 10-point agreement rule. (2) Correction: Denver's RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey carry no injury designation (full practice, denverbroncos.com 9/25) -- only rookie Jonah Coleman is out. Covers expects a low-scoring game (Under 44.5), which favors the side that runs better -- LA with Kyren Williams and Blake Corum. (3) Neither team is 0-2 (both 1-1). If the DK price has moved shorter than -150, the edge is gone -- skip it. If it's moved to -125 or so (Kalshi-like), the edge is a bit bigger.
